description: This file defines a custom runtime exception representing a gateway service timeout scenario within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes class and method definitions to create and handle this specific exception, with support for JSON parsing and building via nested builder class.

classes.name: GatewayServiceTimeoutException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a timeout when an API Gateway proxies a service, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing GatewayException.

classes.name: GatewayServiceTimeoutException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class to create instances of GatewayServiceTimeoutException, supporting fluent API with thread-unsafe annotation.

methods.name: GatewayServiceTimeoutException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for GatewayServiceTimeoutException.

methods.name: GatewayServiceTimeoutException.fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs the exception from a custom message and headers.

methods.name: GatewayServiceTimeoutException.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs the exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: GatewayServiceTimeoutException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
